entries.back_en: "I don't want this place to end up with a curse, like Chamba or Synesta—no way!"
"Does that mean you don't have sandflier parts!?"
"All right then, we'll go to this Sandflier Valley and bring you the material you need."
"Wha-"
"Don't be afraid... I just want some information, that's all. I want you to tell me everything about the monster you say you saw."
"Well!... I'd try to be a little more cooperative if I were you..."
"Otherwise... Things might get a little uncomfortable... And that's not what we want, is it?"
"What do you think you're doing!?"
"Wh... Why are you doing this!? I thought the war was supposed to be over!"
"The war's not over. There's been a cease-fire called, that's all. Do you understand the difference, wench..."
entries.note: 'rapariga' em pt-BR pode soar pejorativo/ofensivo; 'missy' é só condescendente. Prefira 'mocinha'.

entries.back_en: "Wait... You're a Wyndian... Well well, if it isn't the little princess!"
"We were sent to find a dragon, but found a little bird instead! Grab her, men—no reason not to take her too!"
"W...Wait! Do you know something about my sister...!?"
"By the power granted me, I command thee! Warrior spirit! Thou art summoned!"
"Joh...I want you to capture that wench. Be careful not to hurt her... Too much."
entries.note: 'aquela rapariga' para 'that girl' carrega conotação pejorativa indevida; use 'aquela garota'.

entries.back_en: "Ho...What's this? A dashing knight come to save the Princess?"
"How gallant. You know it's a knight's job to protect his lady, right? Where have you been all this time? Afraid, hiding in some closet or..."
"H... How dare you!? You filthy little..."
"L... Let's get out of here...!"
"I wonder if they'd use a hex against us if war came back, like they did with Chamba and Synesta. Just thinking about it scares me!"
entries.note: 'se a guerra voltasse' levemente diferente mas aceitável.

entries.back_en: "I heard a guy passing through say the Empire uses something called a Carronade to put a hex on enemies... Is it true?"
"First Imperial troops in town, then that Carronade of theirs... I guess what they say is true—that another war is starting..."
"I heard those troops were looking for a dragon... I'm just glad they didn't come to 'start' another war!"
"I wish those troops would spend all their energy looking for the dragons and leave us alone!"
"I was on my way here, see, when I saw this big crater in the ground..." "And you fell in it and lost all your stuff, right?"
